The overall palette is extremely clean and light — white, cream, blush/dusty pink, and the jewel-toned splashes of fuchsia and lime green from the ceiling fixture creating small rainbow patches of refracted light on the ceiling surface. Soft, even, diffused daylight fills the room uniformly with minimal shadow, creating a gallery-like brightness. The mood is playful, modern, and artfully light-filled.
